chunks: Muhammad ibn 'Ali ibn Mahbub narrated from al-Hasan ibn 'Ali, from 'Abd Allah ibn al-Mughirah, from 'Ubays ibn Hisham, from Karram, from Abi Basir, who said:
I asked him about recitation in the bathhouse, so he said: “If you have a waist-wrapper on, then recite the Qur'an, if you wish, all of it.”

key_terms.إِزَارٌ: a waist-wrapper or lower garment used for covering
key_terms.الْقِرَاءَةِ: recitation, specifically the act of reading aloud or reciting
key_terms.كُلَّهُ: all of it, in its entirety

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to recite the Qur'an in the bathhouse while covered with an izar?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding reciting the Qur'an in the bathhouse. It indicates that Qur'an recitation is permitted there when one is properly covered with an izar, showing the relevance of bodily covering and decorum in such places.
